item.title: Re: SCP draft Crit
item.content:encoded:
Sorry but I cannot provide critique due to the fact the idea has not been greenlighted yet. I suggest that you go on idea critique before drafting.

Please read
Idea Critique

I did look through your account page and found no indication of any greenlight. Make sure to get your ideas greenlighted first. Thank you.

And sorry no I cannot greenlight your idea but I can critique the idea when you do post of Ideas Critique

item.title: SCP draft Crit
item.content:encoded:
Please only provide the necessary information and don't be rude.

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/maskedn00b4

The top things I'd want critiquing on is:

  • Grammar and punctuation
  • Make sure that the language is cold and professional
  • Flow of sentences
  • Story stuff (Not necessary but if you think it could be better just say your suggestions)

Thanks in advance for your time and effort.
